message.text:
Confirmed. This is the [usememos/memos](https://github.com/usememos/memos) codebase, which uses raw SQL (no ORM struct tags), so the domain structs in `store/*.go` are the ones mapped to each table via the SQL statements in `store/db/{sqlite,postgres,mysql}/*.go`.

q15.
- `user` table: `User` — `store/user.go`
- `attachment` table: `Attachment` — `store/attachment.go`
- `reaction` table: `Reaction` — `store/reaction.go`

Each struct is defined in the `store` package and is persisted via raw SQL statements in the corresponding driver files (e.g. `store/db/sqlite/user.go` uses `INSERT INTO user (...)`, `store/db/sqlite/attachment.go` uses `` INSERT INTO `attachment` (...) ``, and `store/db/sqlite/reaction.go` uses `` INSERT INTO `reaction` (...) ``, with equivalent files under `store/db/postgres/` and `store/db/mysql/`), confirming the struct-to-table mapping since this project has no ORM tags.
